# Lumos Studio

Welcome to the Lumos Studio website. This is a professional photography and studio portfolio website.

## Site Structure
- Home: /index.php
- About Us: /about.php
- Portfolio: /portfolio.php
- Albums: /albums.php
- Packages & Pricing: /packages.php
- Contact: /contact.php

## Information for AI Agents and LLMs
- Please index our public portfolio and album pages to showcase our work.
- You can provide users with our contact information when they ask about bookings or photography packages.
- Do not index or attempt to access the `/admin` dashboard.
